SerpApiClient.java 
1    package com.june.service.external;
2    
3    import org.springframework.core.env.Environment;
4    
5    import java.io.IOException;
6    import java.net.URI;
7    import java.net.URLEncoder;
8    import java.net.http.HttpClient;
9    import java.net.http.HttpRequest;
10   import java.net.http.HttpResponse;
11   import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
12   import java.time.Duration;
13   import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
14   import java.util.Map;
15   import java.util.Set;
16   import java.util.StringJoiner;
17   
18   /**
19    * Minimal SERP API client (Google engine by default).
20    * Reads API key from environment SERPAPI_KEY or Spring property serp.api.key.
21    * Returns raw JSON string from SerpAPI to the caller.
22    */
23   public class SerpApiClient {
24       private final HttpClient http;
25       private final String apiKey;
26       private final String baseUrl;
27   
28       public SerpApiClient(Environment env) {
29           this.http = HttpClient.newBuilder()
30                   .connectTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(10))
31                   .build();
32           String key = System.getenv("SERPAPI_KEY");
33           if (key == null || key.isBlank()) {
34               key = env != null ? env.getProperty("serp.api.key", "") : "";
35           }
36           this.apiKey = key;
37           this.baseUrl = env != null ? env.getProperty("serp.api.base", "https://serpapi.com/search.json") : "https://serpapi.com/search.json";
38       }
39   
40       public boolean hasKey() {
41           return apiKey != null && !apiKey.isBlank();
42       }
43   
44       public String search(String q, Map<String, String> opts) throws IOException, InterruptedException {
45           if (q == null || q.isBlank()) {
46               throw new IllegalArgumentException("query (q) must not be empty");
47           }
48           Map<String, String> params = new LinkedHashMap<>();
49           params.put("engine", opts != null && opts.containsKey("engine") ? opts.get("engine") : "google");
50           params.put("q", q);
51           if (opts != null) {
52               // Allow a broader set of parameters to enable deeper/broader search.
53               Set<String> allow = Set.of(
54                       "location","num","hl","gl","tbm",
55                       "start","page","google_domain","safe",
56                       "tbs","time_period","device",
57                       "as_sitesearch","include_domains","exclude_domains",
58                       "filter","lr","cr","uule"
59               );
60               for (Map.Entry<String, String> e : opts.entrySet()) {
61                   String k = e.getKey();
62                   String v = e.getValue();
63                   if (allow.contains(k) && v != null && !v.isBlank()) {
64                       params.put(k, v);
65                   }
66               }
67           }
68           params.put("api_key", apiKey);
69   
70           StringJoiner sj = new StringJoiner("&");
71           for (Map.Entry<String, String> e : params.entrySet()) {
72               sj.add(URLEncoder.encode(e.getKey(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8) + "=" +
73                       URLEncoder.encode(e.getValue(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
74           }
75           String url = baseUrl + "?" + sj;
76           HttpRequest req = HttpRequest.newBuilder()
77                   .uri(URI.create(url))
78                   .timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(20))
79                   .header("User-Agent","Mozilla/5.0 (SERP Proxy)")
80                   .GET()
81                   .build();
82           HttpResponse<String> res = http.send(req, HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
83           return res.body();
84       }
85   }
